decision: Selected the City of Frankfurt's official building-address point for Heinrich-Lanz-Allee 47 (address object DEHEFALK30007jPd), the address Iron Mountain publishes for FRA-2, transformed from EPSG:25832 to WGS84, as the campus locator.

selected_properties.operator_published_address: Heinrich-Lanz-Allee 47, 60437 Frankfurt am Main (Iron Mountain Frankfurt page, Internet Archive raw copy of 11 June 2026)

consistency_checks.street_query: A prefix query for 'Heinrich-Lanz-Allee' returns 24 features (one street area and 23 building addresses); exactly one is 'Heinrich-Lanz-Allee 47'. The nearest other address on the street is No. 33, 260.6 m away; Nos. 1-38 lie 0.8-0.9 km to the east.
consistency_checks.crs: The geoportal configuration (https://geoportal.frankfurt.de/karte/config.json; Atlas evidence 6eddbcec-13da-5da0-b897-aa866c5c7086, local local_data/country-research-ops-frankfurt-de-p6/frankfurt-geoportal-config.json, rehashed 7 November 2026, sha256 907501e9...3702) sets the geosearch on the same 'elastic' service to epsg 25832, so the coordinates are ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N metres. The same service and transform underlie the Atlas's Equinix FR2/FR7, Telehouse Frankfurt and NorthC FRA01 locators.

transform_check: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy; rounded to 7 decimal places; the rounded point transforms back to within 0.0051 m.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Map widgets or map links on Iron Mountain pages
excluded_coordinates.reason: Not read or used (locator source policy).

excluded_coordinates.kind: Frankfurt city centre and Iron Mountain's FRA-1 address (Borsigallee 1)

limitations: The point is the register's building-address point for the published address; it is not a parcel, building footprint or surveyed position, and the register states no positional accuracy.
